answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through environmental proof-of-presence. Agents authenticate by proving local physical entropy, such as acoustic resonance in a limestone karst or diffuse light through an opal filter. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware and deployment cost of maintaining dedicated sensor rigs per persona. However, regional anomalies like saffron dust haze homogenize readings across adjacent nodes, degrading entropy and permitting localized spoofing.
